subject: Your thesis just got a new weapon
preview_text: I just finished building something that will save you 3 hours on your next paper. Check it out.
body_paragraphs: Remember that 2AM panic when your thesis statement just won't click? I've been there too. So I spent the last month coding something I wish I had when I was staring at a blank page at 3AM. And you get to see it first.

Starting next week, Thesis Generator will auto-generate full counterarguments for your thesis. No more wrestling with 'but what about the other side?' or losing hours digging for opposing views. It's like having a debate partner who never sleeps and knows every source.

Here's the deal: you can test a beta version right now. Open the app, tap on any thesis you've saved, and you'll see a new button called 'Counterargument Mode.' Click it, and watch the app pull in real academic sources to poke holes in your argument—so you can patch them before your professor does.

This feature will be Premium-only in a month. But since you're an early user, I'm giving you free access until Friday. Open the app, find a thesis you're working on, and hit that button. P.S. The first 100 people to use it and reply with feedback get a month of Premium for free.
